title: Automation on sends, group and return tracks and numbered devices lands on the right control
description:
As a producer, I want automation on sends, group and return tracks, and on a second device of a kind, to land on the right control, so that every automated move is kept.

```gherkin
Feature: Automation lands on the right control
  Scenario: A send level
    Given the track "a" sends to "plate" and has "automate send plate 1=0% 9=40%"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the send from "a" to "plate" has an envelope from 0% to 40% over bars 1 to 9

  Scenario: A group track and a return track
    Given the group track "beat" has "automate volume 1=-12dB 5=0dB"
    And the return track "plate" has "automate reverb.mix 1=100% 5=50%"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the group track "beat" has a volume envelope
    And the Reverb on "plate" has a dry/wet envelope

  Scenario: The second device of a kind
    Given the track "a" has two eqs and "automate eq2.highcut 1=20k 5=4k"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the second EQ Eight on "a" has a high cut envelope
    And the first has none

  Scenario: A track spread over several audio tracks
    Given the track "stab" plays notes that overlap and has "automate pan 1=-50 5=50"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the group track "stab" has the pan envelope
```
